advice_items.quote: if I just hung out with authentic good high energy people they were eventually going to be successful and then I would eventually be successful if I kind of played the long game
advice_items.summary_en: Surround yourself with authentic, high-energy people and play the long game so you succeed alongside them.
advice_items.summary_zh: 结交真诚高能量的人并打持久战共同成长

advice_items.canonical_tag: Choose the Right Industry / Big Market
advice_items.quote: I would say data scientists that would be an industry that I would look at... analytics is a massive now
advice_items.summary_en: Target fast-growing, high-demand fields such as data science and analytics when launching a career.
advice_items.summary_zh: 选择数据科学和商业分析等高增长赛道

advice_items.quote: any sales position you'd want to be at a place where you're on a team because it's lonely to be in sales... team selling is huge
advice_items.summary_en: Join a collaborative sales team rather than selling alone on an island so you can share wins and stay resilient.
advice_items.summary_zh: 在销售中融入团队协作而非单打独斗

advice_items.quote: I am rarely on the calls anymore I'm just pretty much coaching on strategy so some of our sales folks they're technically brilliant
advice_items.summary_en: Hire technically brilliant salespeople so you can step away from day-to-day calls and focus on coaching strategy.
advice_items.summary_zh: 打造专业强悍团队并退居幕后专攻战略辅导

advice_items.canonical_tag: Solve Real Pain Points & Deliver Value
advice_items.quote: they're likable they're personable they care about the clients and they have very very creative solutions
advice_items.summary_en: Truly care about clients and deliver creative solutions tailored to their operational headaches.
advice_items.summary_zh: 真心关心客户并提供极具创意的解决方案

advice_items.quote: it's a secret sauce also to really know how to talk to talk versus just being that generalist
advice_items.summary_en: Develop deep expertise in specific industry verticals so you speak your clients' language instead of acting as a generalist.
advice_items.summary_zh: 深耕细分垂直行业做专家而非泛泛通才

advice_items.quote: I read a boatload of books and now I listen to books on occasion as well so I probably read or listen to three to five books a month
advice_items.summary_en: Build a consistent habit of reading or listening to three to five books every month.
advice_items.summary_zh: 保持每月阅读或听书三到五本的习惯

advice_items.quote: don't sweat the small stuff it's all small stuff... 95 of stuff that happens isn't really a big deal... you have to be calm during chaos
advice_items.summary_en: Remember that 95% of problems are small stuff and stay calm during chaos.
advice_items.summary_zh: 看淡日常琐事，在混乱与危机中保持冷静

advice_items.quote: we are huge huge Believers in quantity of time with kids... knowing that you as a parent you're always around you're always there
advice_items.summary_en: Invest quantity of time in your children, show affection, and take a breath before entering home so you are fully present for your spouse.
advice_items.summary_zh: 重视陪伴孩子的时间长度并全心陪伴伴侣

advice_items.quote: I start off every day with a Triple Espresso in my parlor... and I do a few minutes of meditation
advice_items.summary_en: Anchor every morning with a consistent personal routine such as coffee and a few minutes of meditation.
advice_items.summary_zh: 每天清晨坚持喝浓缩咖啡并冥想几分钟

advice_items.quote: for 30 seconds to five minutes just gratitude towards my family towards I get to work today
advice_items.summary_en: Take 30 seconds to five minutes every morning to practice gratitude for your family and opportunity to work.
advice_items.summary_zh: 每天早晨花几分钟向家人与工作机会感恩

advice_items.quote: come up with a plan and then they need to have the tenacity and the wherewithal to execute on that plan... a lot of people give up I think a day a week a month before their business was gonna freaking go to the Moon
advice_items.summary_en: Create a concrete plan and execute with relentless tenacity rather than quitting right before a breakthrough.
advice_items.summary_zh: 制定计划并顽强执行，切忌在爆发前夜放弃

advice_items.quote: decompress get away from your phone get away from your computer... alone time is when get hit with that random thought of how to make your business better
advice_items.summary_en: Disconnect from phones and computers for uninterrupted alone time to decompress, reflect, and spark business ideas.
advice_items.summary_zh: 远离手机电脑独处反思，激发商业改善灵感

advice_items.quote: diversifying so putting money in the market putting money in real estate I think is really smart I've also always put money in private companies so private Equity
advice_items.summary_en: Diversify investments across the stock market, real estate, private companies/PE, and even hobbies you know well.
advice_items.summary_zh: 将资金分散配置于股市、房产及私募股权

advice_items.quote: besides being an honorable hard-working incredible husband and father I would say authentic just real I tell it like it is
advice_items.summary_en: Build your legacy on honor, hard work, and being genuinely authentic and straightforward.
advice_items.summary_zh: 做人正直坦率表里如一，兼顾家庭与商界口碑

guests.first_money_or_break: 大学毕业后在芝加哥做猎头但一个月后因受不了严寒早起辞职，随后进入大公司派驻圣路易斯积累经验；后为照顾守寡母亲回家乡进入商业保险行业做销售（producer），前3-4年不断摸索，坚持25年以上将原公司发展为2000人规模的私募股权整合（PE roll-up）企业并成功出售，后加入Virtus Insurance担任合伙人及销售负责人。
recommended_books_or_mentors: Don't Sweat the Small Stuff... and It's All Small Stuff
guests.role_or_title: Head of Sales & Partner at Virtus Insurance (Former Insurance PE Roll-Up Executive)
guests.zero_start_advice: 如果账户明天归零，会立刻重返全职销售岗位，靠比别人更拼、更努力（out-hustle/outwork）快速赚取佣金支票；随后将资金分散投资于股市、房地产、私募股权/初创公司及个人热爱并熟悉的收藏爱好领域。
